description: JavaScript class for managing the display and interactions of a past order summary in a Point of Sale system, including rendering order details, handling email and print actions, and managing UI events.

classes.name: erpnext.PointOfSale.PastOrderSummary
classes.description: Class managing the display, interaction, and actions related to a past order summary in POS.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the class with wrapper and events, then sets up the component.

methods.name: init_component
methods.description: Initializes the component by preparing DOM, dialogs, event bindings, and shortcuts.

methods.name: prepare_dom
methods.description: Creates and appends the HTML structure for the order summary.

methods.name: init_email_print_dialog
methods.description: Sets up email and print dialogs using frappe.ui.Dialog.

methods.name: get_upper_section_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for the upper section displaying customer and order info.

methods.name: get_item_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual order items.

methods.name: get_discount_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for discount information.

methods.name: get_net_total_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for net total.

methods.name: get_taxes_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for taxes.

methods.name: get_grand_total_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for grand total.

methods.name: get_payment_html
methods.description: Generates HTML for payment method and amount.

methods.name: bind_events
methods.description: Binds click events for order actions like return, edit, delete, email, and print.

methods.name: print_receipt
methods.description: Triggers printing of the receipt.

methods.name: attach_shortcuts
methods.description: Adds keyboard shortcuts for print, new order, and edit actions.

methods.name: send_email
methods.description: Sends the order summary via email using frappe call.

methods.name: add_summary_btns
methods.description: Adds action buttons based on the current state.

methods.name: toggle_summary_placeholder
methods.description: Shows or hides the placeholder when no order is loaded.

methods.name: get_condition_btn_map
methods.description: Returns button visibility conditions based on order status.

methods.name: load_summary_of
methods.description: Loads and displays the order summary for a given document.

methods.name: attach_document_info
methods.description: Fetches customer email and updates upper section HTML.

methods.name: attach_items_info
methods.description: Populates items container with order items.

methods.name: set_dynamic_rate_header_width
methods.description: Adjusts width of rate/disc columns for alignment.

methods.name: attach_payments_info
methods.description: Populates payments container with payment info.

methods.name: attach_totals_info
methods.description: Populates totals, taxes, discounts, and grand total.

methods.name: toggle_component
methods.description: Shows or hides the entire order summary component.
